evals.prompt: Create a concise how-to guide for rotating a synthetic test credential. The repository already defines the commands and verification check. Do not invent production policy.
evals.expected_output: A task-oriented guide grounded in supplied repository authority, with prerequisites, ordered action, verification, and no invented policy.
assertions: The primary reader job is explicit and preserved.
Commands and checks remain grounded in repository authority.
The guide distinguishes prerequisites, action, and verification.
No production policy or unrelated implementation is invented.

evals.prompt: Review and improve this one README for structure and clarity. Keep its accepted technical meaning and update any required navigation.
evals.expected_output: A bounded one-document review and revision that preserves accepted meaning, fixes the reader journey, and checks related navigation.
assertions: The work stays bounded to the identified document and required links.
Accepted technical meaning is preserved.
The revised structure serves one primary reader job.
The handoff does not claim a corpus audit or independent approval.

evals.prompt: Assess whether the entire documentation corpus is healthy, complete, current, and discoverable. Do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: A snapshot-bound, read-only documentation audit with declared scope and coverage, strengths, traceable findings, limitations, and routed recommendations.
assertions: The response binds scope and a repository revision, release, or observation time before making broad claims.
Coverage and blind spots are explicit.
Strengths to preserve and material limitations are explicit.
Findings separate evidence, impact, expected state, and route.
Every material recommendation names its next route or owner.
No files are changed.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this README so a new contributor can complete setup and verify success.
assertions: The selected skill is author-docs.
No neighboring skill is selected for a job it does not own.
Routing uses only catalog names and descriptions.
No task side effect occurs before selection.

evals.prompt: Create two neighboring how-to guides from supplied synthetic authority: one for scheduled test-credential expiry and one for suspected test-credential exposure. Give each guide a metadata description and index entry that lets a reader choose before opening it.
evals.expected_output: Two bounded guides whose canonical descriptions distinguish their selection conditions and supported outcomes, whose index entries copy those descriptions exactly, and whose prerequisites remain distinct from selection conditions.
assertions: Each guide description names the observable situation or reader intent that makes the guide relevant.
Each guide description names the outcome or decision the guide supports.
The two descriptions distinguish scheduled expiry from suspected exposure before either guide is opened.
Preconditions are not mislabeled as selection conditions or triggering events.
Each index entry copies its concept's canonical description exactly.

evals.prompt: Audit the documentation set under docs/ for discovery, accuracy, coverage, and maintenance risks. Do not change it.
assertions: The selected skill is author-docs.
The request is recognized as a documentation-corpus audit rather than a skill audit or general research task.
Routing uses only catalog names and descriptions.
No task side effect occurs before selection.

evals.prompt: Audit and fix our documentation. First determine what is wrong across docs/, then make whatever changes are needed.
evals.expected_output: A diagnostic finding set completed before bounded remediation, without silently widening or changing the corpus during the audit stage.
assertions: The audit contract and coverage are resolved before edits.
The diagnostic stage does not mutate documentation.
Accepted findings are traceable into the authoring changes.
Material information-architecture decisions remain user-authorized.

evals.prompt: Audit a bounded synthetic collection of neighboring guides. Their titles and descriptions say what each guide contains, but omit the situations in which a reader should choose one over another. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: A read-only discovery and form-fit finding that identifies the missing selection conditions, distinguishes them from prerequisites, and recommends bounded documentation remediation.
assertions: The audit identifies that readers cannot choose confidently from the concept previews.
The expected state requires a selection condition and supported outcome for each action-oriented description.
The finding does not demand a literal event trigger for every voluntarily selected guide.
Preconditions are not treated as a substitute for selection conditions.
No documentation files are changed.
